title: Accessibility variant (large-print / dyslexia-friendly / high-contrast)
context: Packs must be usable by people with low vision, dyslexia, or in low-light field conditions, so an accessibility variant of the print template is defined (large-print, dyslexia-friendly, high-contrast). A qualified reviewer checks the variant. It builds on the print template.
objective: Specify an accessibility variant of the pocket-card template (large-print / dyslexia-friendly / high-contrast).
acceptanceCriteria: Defines large-print, dyslexia-friendly, and high-contrast variants that preserve tiering, pictograms, and the mandatory disclaimer
Maintains print-first, B/W-safe and fold-to-pocket constraints (or documents the trade-off)
Reviewed for legibility/usability by a qualified reviewer
Render path documented so accessible packs are reproducible
